prv.title: Privacy & data
prv.sub: How long orders keep the internet address, device and shared location, the clean-up that removes them, and customers' requests to erase their details.
prv.overdueNote: {n} order(s) are past the period and still hold these facts. The clean-up runs in the background worker; if this does not go to zero within the hour, look at Reports › Server.

keep.h: What orders keep, and for how long
keep.d: For the risk checks an order keeps the internet address, the device and (when the customer shares it) the location. The clean-up removes them after the period; the order, its money and its history stay.
keep.retentionHelp: 180 days by default. After this, the clean-up removes them from the order.
keep.erasureRequests: Take customers' requests to erase their details
keep.erasureHelp: Off by default. When on, the team can file a request below; only the owner carries it out.

consent.d: Who agreed to offers by SMS or WhatsApp, and every change with when and where, is on Messages › Consent.

req.d: A customer asked to remove his personal details. Filing a request changes nothing; the owner carries it out. Money and stock records stay; the message log, the consent history, the security log and fraud checks are kept as the record.
req.off: Erasure requests are off. Turn them on in the card above to take one.
req.reason: What he asked, and how (phone, shop, message)
req.filed: Request filed. The owner can carry it out below.
confirmEffects: His name, numbers, e-mail, birthday and saved addresses are removed from his profile and his orders. This cannot be undone.
His orders, their money and stock stay; the courier records keep the order numbers only.
He can no longer sign in; a new order makes a new profile.

err.STALE: Someone else changed this card; it shows their values now.
err.CONFIRM_MISMATCH: Type the word exactly as shown.
err.OPEN_ORDERS: One of his orders is still on its way. Erase after it is delivered or returned.
err.ALREADY_REQUESTED: A request for this customer is waiting already.
err.NOT_WAITING: This request is already done or cancelled.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
err.unauthorized: Your sign-in has ended — please sign in again.
err.other: That did not work. Please try again.

prv.readOnly: You can see these settings; changing them needs the security permission.
